name: St. Louise Regional Hospital Volunteers (students 16 and up)
org: Santa Clara Valley Healthcare, St. Louise Regional Hospital
what_you_do: You help patients, families and staff. You might work at the front desk, in the gift shop, in some care areas or at community events.
who_can_apply: Students age 16 or older and adults. No summer-only volunteering.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The page links to an online application with no window stated (read 2026-10-16).
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer form online. Questions? Call the volunteer office at 408-852-2521.
notes: Read on the official St. Louise Regional Hospital page on 2026-10-16. It is South County's community hospital in Gilroy. The page does not state hours, commitment length, health screening, TB test or fees; ask the volunteer office. The page shows an email address whose link points to a different address, so call the phone number instead.
